text: Can you make an ad for Neon Night, please? I’m excited about this and keep picturing how it’ll feel when the event details finally appear. It needs to be 8 seconds long and vertical, and the event is on 12 September 2026 at The Foundry, Leeds. Start with a big countdown showing 3, then 2, then 1, with building electronic beats and flashing neon. Then reveal the event name, date and venue, and hold that end card so I can read it. No talking, please.
